revision_note: v2 rewrites the three Vietnamese prompts in actual Vietnamese. v1 wrote them with diacritics stripped, which is not Vietnamese text, while the verifier requires a Vietnamese answer - an unfair test rather than a measurement. Found after running v1; both results are recorded. No other prompt or expectation was changed, and in particular gr-02 was left alone: the model answered 'Oxygen' when asked which gas plants absorb, which is a real error and not the harness's fault.
